Subject: AP readiness & payment path — Helix Biotech (PO vs card / marketplace)

Hi Lydia — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the procurement side: 

Key items from our conversation:
- AP process: Helix requires a vendor form + W-9 and a formal PO for any purchase > $10k.
- Short-term need: pilot scope ~ $7k (estimated first month).
- Card payment: Victor indicated corporate card is blocked for new vendors unless pre-approved by Finance; exceptions possible but rare.
- Marketplace: Helix Procurement is open to marketplace purchases if vendor is listed and pricing is identical.

My asks / next steps: 
1) Can you share the vendor onboarding form and the preferred PO template (attachment: helix_ap_supplier_form.xlsx) — I attached a Redwood checklist to speed this.
2) Confirm whether your team can issue a PO at pilot size or whether we should pursue a card exception (who to contact for exceptions?).
3) If marketplace is preferred, confirm the marketplace name (AWS Marketplace / GCP Marketplace / Azure) and whether listing is required before acceptance.

I've attached: quick-procurement-checklist.pdf (summary for AP), and a blank supplier form placeholder (helix_ap_supplier_form.xlsx).

I can loop in our finance ops to expedite vendor setup if you'd like — we can also offer a short trial via Marketplace if listing is possible within 2 weeks.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick follow-up with Victor if that helps.

Best,
Dylan Brooks

Thanks Dylan — great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- I uploaded the supplier form and PO template to this thread (see helix_ap_supplier_form.xlsx). Victor and our AP lead (ap@helixbiotech.com) are cc'ed.
- For pilot size (~$7k): Finance prefers card for anything under $10k, but because Redwood is not yet a registered vendor in our system the card charges will fail until vendor setup is complete.
- Marketplace: we typically only allow AWS Marketplace purchases for ISVs that have a current contract and listing; GCP/Azure are rarely used by our procurement team.
- Exception path: Victor can route to Finance for a one-off card exception, but turnaround is 5–7 business days.

Next steps from Helix: 
1) I'll initiate vendor onboarding today — you should receive a request from ap@helixbiotech.com to complete the supplier profile and upload certs.
2) If you can send a short SOW + final pilot quote, I will prepare a PO request in parallel.
3) If Redwood can accept card while vendor setup completes, let us know the credit card billing contact (we will need company billing name + tax details).

Lydia

C) Delay pilot until marketplace listing is complete (2–3 weeks).

- Fill and return vendor form as soon as ap@helixbiotech.com sends it.
- Hold dates for a potential kickoff week starting May 31st.
